proc_rules.roll: Once on the first successful direct target per offensive action; listed core chance.
proc_rules.source_values: Base P0/E0 after component passives, before forging state and forge multipliers. Prevents recursive scaling.
proc_rules.stacking: Same named status refreshes duration, never stacks; different sources use strongest magnitude.
proc_rules.duration: Target completed actions, not seconds. Wielder effects use wielder actions.
proc_rules.limits: Hard-control immune bosses receive listed substitutes; all effects respect immunity flags.
proc_rules.secondary_hits: DoTs, echoes, splashes, bursts and shatter cannot roll weapon procs.
proc_rules.cracked: Core proc chance gains 4 percentage points per excess forge strike, capped at 50%; effect magnitude unchanged.
proc_rules.friendly_fire: All persistent ground damage and terminal/ordnance bursts affect both sides. Other listed extra-enemy effects target enemies only.
proc_rules.critical: Direct hits only; critical damage 1.5x before defense; proc damage and terminal bursts cannot crit.
proc_rules.armor: Attack values are pre-defense weapon contribution, not promised final HP damage. Combat integration determines defense formula.
